_comment: Test-career setups for fm15_cli.py harness. Nation entries are FM's 3-letter codes, optionally CODE-n where n is the 0-based index of the lowest active division (same numbers FM writes in last_normal_nations.xml); a bare code loads every division. 'team' is a club's database unique id, or -1 to start unemployed (unverified). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD and are written in FM's date order from date_format.xml.

eng-fra.description: England and France playable, the user's other usual nations view-only

smoke-holiday.description: Harness test: England only, smallest database, an unemployed manager on holiday, save on 1 Aug 2014 and quit

test-holiday.description: Harness test: England only, smallest database, an unemployed manager on holiday; stop with `holiday --until`

big5.description: Parity test: top two divisions of England, Spain, Germany, Italy and France; an unemployed manager on holiday
